edges.reason: Owned constructor is executed with msg.sender which is then granted owner rights.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable at deployment.
IFC constructor is invoked by the deployer and mints the initial supply.
Constructor assigns 15000e18 to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the full supply to a hardcoded holder in balances.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership body runs.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before proceeding.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner to address(0).
transfer is executed by the caller whose balance is debited.
balances[msg.sender] is read and rewritten inside transfer.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
The to parameter indexes the credited balances entry.
transfer performs the safeSub balance debit operation.
The tokens parameter is the subtrahend in the balance debit.
The result of safeSub is written back into balances.
approve is called by the token holder granting the allowance.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter becomes the second index of allowed.
The tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
transferFrom is called by the spender spending an allowance.
The from parameter indexes the debited balances entry.
The to parameter indexes the credited balances entry.
The tokens parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance.

The debited balance result is stored back into balances.
The reduced allowance is stored back into allowed.

The tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.

approveAndCall transfers control to an arbitrary spender contract.
